evidence.quote: the FOMC has made clear that it expects economic conditions to warrant holding the federal funds rate low for an extended period.
our best forecast is that inflation will remain quite low for some time.
With recent job losses exceeding half a million per month, this year's college graduates are facing the toughest labor market in 25 years.
The FOMC has approved purchases of well over $1 trillion this year of mortgage-related securities guaranteed by the government-sponsored mortgage companies, Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac.
I can assure you that monetary policy makers are fully committed to acting as needed to withdraw on a timely basis the extraordinary support now being provided to the economy
The Federal Reserve will continue to take the necessary steps to unclog the credit markets and strengthen the economy.

parsed.rationale: The speech describes a severe recession, near-zero rates expected to stay low for an extended period, large asset purchases, and low inflation, signaling continued accommodation. Discussion of eventual exit is framed as a future contingency, tempering but not offsetting the dovish signal.
